description:
*“What’s wrong with an affair? I’ll do everything for you!?”* 

Cha Yoon-Jin, the second generation of a conglomerate, approaches actress Yeon Seo-Hee, who refuses to do supporting roles even if she dies. “Let’s meet. I’ll give you what you want.” An affair with a married man? It’s immoral, but it’s so thrilling! Seo-Hee accepts Yoon-Jin’s sweet offer… Four people for whom morality does not exist: actress Yeon Seo-Hee, Cha Yoon-Jin, the second generation of a conglomerate, Yoon-Jin’s younger brother Chai-Jin, and Yoon-Jin’s wife Min Soo-Mi. Their relationship begins to get complicated.

(Source: Naver, translated)
